errors.text_span: The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the largest and proceeding to the smallest.
errors.evidence: The description claims the slices are ordered clockwise by descending size, starting from the largest slice. However, starting from the largest slice ("Null" at 39.2%), the next slice clockwise is the smallest slice ("Have test case" at 21.9%), which breaks the descending order. The slices are actually ordered by ascending size in a clockwise direction, starting from the smallest slice.
